'''Utoz Houses''' were social establishments on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]], especially in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Caronath]]. Utoz Houses served many brands of [[Utoz/Legends|Utoz]], a popular fermented [[malt]] beverage considered to be a delicacy on the planet.
